mentions.name: Flow (Facets-cloud/flow)
mentions.description: A tool that manages Claude sessions by mapping them to real-life tasks, with a scoop/sweep mechanism that automatically populates a knowledgebase, turning Claude into something like a personal assistant.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://github.com/Facets-cloud/flow

It does a few things for me:

- Claude session management mapping it to real life tasks

- A scoop/sweep mechanism to auto-populate the Knowledgebase

It has turned my claude to more of a PA.
